parent: DEV-044A draft PR #200, data-dependent DEV-045 main comparison not yet registered
hypothesis: An action-conditioned cost/ranking interface can be implemented without letting privileged simulator labels leak into inference
scope: bounded vectorized two-action cost comparator and optional inspect value-of-information forecast; differentiable decision regret loss, explicit admissibility mask, do-not-default-to-WAIT fallback
boundary: learned action probabilities must be produced solely from observations and verified state; evaluator oracle cost labels only passed to training loss/audit
outcomes: expected total downstream cost after inspection and contingent policy
preliminary_tests: WAIT when risk below true cost threshold
SERVICE when expected failure reduction outweighs service
INSPECT only with explicit value-of-information estimate and admissibility
HUMAN_REVIEW when all actions masked; no implicit wait
non-zero gradient for decision regret when cost differs
never grant ground-truth labels to deployment forward
evidence_gate: Engineering unit tests only. A future DEV-045 main protocol must freeze DEV-044 results, train with disjoint cases and pass independent physical replay; current code does not establish downstream utility.
